definitions.explanation: Something done incorrectly; an error in action, judgment, or calculation.
An unintended event, especially something improper or unfortunate.

examples.japanese: {計算|けいさん}に{間違|まちが}いがあった。
examples.english: There was a mistake in the calculation.

examples.japanese: {間違|まちが}いなく{届|とど}けます。
examples.english: I will definitely deliver it (without fail).
examples.notes: {間違|まちが}いなく = without mistake, certainly

examples.japanese: それは{間違|まちが}いだ。{正|ただ}しい{答|こた}えはこれだ。
examples.english: That's wrong. This is the correct answer.

notes:
COMMON EXPRESSIONS:
・{間違|まちが}いない (no mistake, certain, for sure)
・{間違|まちが}いなく (definitely, without fail)
・{間違|まちが}いを{犯|おか}す (to make a mistake)
・{間違|まちが}いを{正|ただ}す (to correct a mistake)
・{間違|まちが}い{電話|でんわ} (wrong number)

RELATED VERB:
・{間違|まちが}う (to make a mistake) - intransitive
・{間違|まちが}える (to mistake X for Y) - transitive
